broadcasts.message: Final normalize.js: NFKC, lowercase, collapse all Unicode whitespace (including NBSP and other space variants) to one ASCII space, then trim. Non-string input returns ''. Faithful to spec—no word reordering, addition, or removal. Compatible with tokenizer's regex and pipeline's expectations. Library complete.
Final tokenizer: calls normalize(text), extracts ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes, returns array in input order. Empty input yields empty array. No changes needed.

Final pipeline.js is complete. processText calls tokenize once, returns {text, tokens, count, unique, frequencies} exactly as specified. Frequencies use a null-prototype object to safely handle 'constructor' and other prototype names. Unique preserves first-seen order. Text is tokens joined with spaces. No changes needed across all rounds.

private_memories.normalizer: Round 4 final. Own normalize.js only. Implementation is complete and correct per spec: NFKC, lowercase, collapse all Unicode whitespace to single ASCII space, trim. Non-string returns ''. No word reordering, dropping, or insertion. All peers confirm compatibility. Final code delivered.
private_memories.tokenizer: Round 4 final: Tokenizer implementation is complete and stable. Spec: tokenize calls injected normalize(text), extracts ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes using regex /[A-Za-z0-9]+(?:'[A-Za-z0-9]+)*/g, returns array in input order. Empty or non-string input yields empty array via match returning null. No shadowing of injected normalize. All peers agree no changes needed.
private_memories.integrator: Round 4 final: All modules stable and correct. pipeline.js unchanged: processText calls tokenize exactly once, returns exact shape with null-prototype frequencies to handle prototype names like constructor. Unique preserves first-seen order. Text is tokens.join(' '). No shadowing of injected dependencies. Faithful processing maintained. Final code ready.
